Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in applying scientific principles regarding shadows. It incorrectly stated that a shadow is shortest when the sun's "heating effect is maximal" (which occurs in the afternoon due to thermal inertia), whereas the physical reality is that a shadow is shortest when the sun is at its highest point in the sky (solar noon), regardless of temperature. Furthermore, the Planner incorrectly associated the time of the shortest shadow with "Daylight Saving Time offsets" shifting solar noon to 1:00 pm, leading it to select 4:05 PM as the answer. The correct answer is 12:05 PM (solar noon), which corresponds to option B.
